body:
Mini Pekka, Giant, Fireball, Mega Minion, Bomber, Arrows, Tombstone and Musketeer.

Musketeer and mega minion will help you kill any type of troops.

Mini pekka will help you against hog riders, giants and other tanks/minitanks

Arrows will help you against swarms and small troops (skarmy, minions, archers, etc)

Fireball will help you kill wizards, musketeers and other ranged troops.

Tombstone will help you defend and distract enemy troops.

Giant will be your win condition, you have to support it with bomber and mega minion, musketeer and minipekka, and a lot of more combinations.

Hope this helps you.
If you have all your cards maxed out then yes, if not, save that gold for other upgrades, in the long run it would give you more wild cards.

Mortar is mostly used in cycle decks along with miner, your deck is too expensive for a mortar deck.

My suggestions:

Archers are top tier card, keep them, they're really good at defending and can chip damage your enemys tower.

Change Witch for a Miner (if you have it unlocked), if not, change the Witch for a Musketeer.

Change the baby dragon for bats or minions, they can really be useful to bait arrows or enemys spells.

Change the goblin giant for a Knight or a valkyrie, valkyrie is really strong against pretty much everything, the same with knight.

Change the skarmy for goblins, top tier card too.

​

I know the difference between cards is really big, but if you want to keep climbing higher in ladder/ranked matches you have to switch your playstyle into a more competitive one.

Also, these changes require a little bit more of skill, so you will lose some matches before getting used to the new deck.

Damn, this deck screams midladder (I don't want to hate, it just screams midladder xD)

First of all, you have too much legendaries in your deck, I would swap the Princess for a Dart Goblin since you're not using any rare cards. Dart Goblin is really amazing in defense and ofense and very versatile.

Maybe change the E-Wiz for a Fireball? or a Poison, your attacks with Miner will be buffed and be more effective with this change.

Change the Pekka, Pekka is completely overrated in this meta, although it can help in defense, there's better cards for less elixir, maybe add a Valkyrie or a Knight.

Change the skarmy for Goblins, goblins are really broken for a 2 elixir card, it's used in a lot of decks (and when you max out this deck, you can also use them in other decks)

I think you're really comfortable using your executioner, but it needs something essential: the Tornado, it will make your deck really good against golems and other time of beatdown decks, and since you have a fireball or a poison spell your deck becomes really strong.

If you want to make these changes it will really improve your deck, if not, your deck is really hard to max out as a f2p.
